answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. It is like tending a raven garden, watching a cipher bird settle, and feeling the calm of a glacier at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
